title: 第21章 都说了我炼丹从来没有副作用第22章 讨伐李贼必须让李玄付出代价
slug: 师弟你的丹药太不正经了
content_zh:
“她就是喜欢我，不然为什么只花我的灵石？！”
一时间，整个丹顶峰突然变得群魔乱舞。
无数足以惊掉下巴的言论回荡在丹顶峰上。
那些喂养灵兽吞下丹药的弟子直接愣神。
有些反应快的一把捂住灵兽嘴巴，转头就跑。
剩下的有样学样，纷纷逃走，不敢回头。
甚至都带上面纱将面容给遮掩起来。
不知道是谁突然喊了一句。
“李玄师兄炼制的醒脉丹有副作用！”
原本还在排队购买醒脉丹的灵兽峰弟子面露惊愕之色。
“我本以为金刚丹已经天下无敌了，不曾想这醒脉丹更是重量级。”
“没想到孙武师弟还有这种癖好，喜欢和别人叫妈妈。”
“赵倩师姐这么美貌动人，怎么能是别人的舔狗，不~~~~”
李玄见得眼前的场景倒是神色淡然。
丹药副作用根本无法隐藏，纸包不住火。
迟早都要被其他同门所得知，不如破罐子破摔。
冷月涵原本还在兴高采烈的数着灵石。
察觉到诸位师弟师妹的异样后，忽的着急起来。
“师弟，咱们总不能做一锤子买卖吧，还有好多的灵石没有赚取呢。”
李玄无奈扶额回应道。

“都说了我炼制的丹药从来都没有副作用，这叫双重效果，他们会理解的。”
恰好他的目光被失魂落魄的上官柔儿吸引。
上官柔儿双目无神，嘴里呢喃不停。
“我是灵兽峰的罪人，我是灵兽峰的罪人，我是……”
李玄随手将储物袋丢过去，恰好落在上官柔儿的手中。
“喏，你的那份利润。”
上官柔儿先是歪头露出可爱的疑惑之色。
待到法力探入其中，看着密密麻麻的灵石。
她的眼中闪烁着名为贪婪的光芒，忽的兴奋改口。
“师弟师妹们怎么能不买呢，这么好的丹药为什么会不买呢？”
财帛动人心在此刻有了具象化的体现。
正待李玄准备解释的时候，恰好何云经过。
content_en:
"She just likes me, otherwise why would she only spend my spiritual stones?!"
For a moment, the entire Dan Peak suddenly became a chaotic dance of demons.
Countless jaw-dropping remarks echoed across Dan Dingding.
Those disciples who fed the spirit beasts and swallowed the pills were stunned.
Some reacted quickly and covered the spirit beast's mouth, turned around and ran away.
The rest followed suit and ran away one after another, not daring to look back.
They even wear veils to cover their faces.
I don't know who suddenly shouted.
"The Awakening Pulse Pill refined by Senior Brother Li Xuan has side effects!"
The Spirit Beast Peak disciples who were originally queuing up to buy the Awakening Pulse Pill looked shocked.
"I thought that the Diamond Pill was already invincible, but I never thought that the Awakening Pulse Pill would be even more powerful."
"I didn't expect that Junior Brother Sun Wu has this kind of hobby. He likes to call others mom."
"Senior Sister Zhao Qian is so beautiful, how can she be someone else's licking dog? No~~~~"
Li Xuan looked indifferent when he saw the scene in front of him.
The side effects of elixirs cannot be hidden at all, and paper cannot contain the fire.
Sooner or later, other fellow students will find out, so it is better to break the jar and throw it away.
Leng Yuehan was still counting the spirit stones happily.
After noticing the strangeness of the junior brothers and sisters, they suddenly became anxious.
"Junior brother, we can't just make a one-time deal, there are still a lot of spiritual stones that we haven't earned yet."
Li Xuan helplessly raised his forehead and responded.
"I told you that the elixirs I refine never have side effects. This is called a double effect. They will understand."
It happened that his eyes were attracted by Shangguan Rou'er who was in a state of despair.
Shangguan Rouer's eyes were dull and she kept mumbling.
"I am the sinner of Spirit Beast Peak, I am the sinner of Spirit Beast Peak, I am..."
Li Xuan casually threw the storage bag over, and it happened to fall into Shangguan Rouer's hands.
"Here, your share of the profits."
Shangguan Rouer first tilted her head, showing a cute look of confusion.
When the mana penetrated it, he looked at the densely packed spiritual stones.
Her eyes flashed with a light called greed, and she suddenly changed her words in excitement.
"How can junior brothers and sisters not buy it? Why don't you buy such a good elixir?"
Money and silk are moving people's hearts and have a concrete manifestation at this moment.
Just when Li Xuan was about to explain, He Yun happened to pass by.
